answer: The strongest lever is simple: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because mesa only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, prism is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any anchor approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
